description: PHP source file defining a class 'MockListener' that implements the Symfony EventSubscriberInterface to listen for kernel request events and potentially mock the IP address based on configuration.

classes.name: MockListener
classes.description: A class that subscribes to Symfony kernel request events to modify request data for debugging or testing purposes.

methods.name: onKernelRequest
methods.description: Handles kernel request events; if in debug mode and mocks are configured, it overrides the IP address.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array associating the kernel request event with the handler method 'onKernelRequest' with priority 100.
